title: 第14章 周伯
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
矿道深处有动静。

    不是脚步声，是鞋底蹭碎石的声。极轻，但每一步都落在同一个点上，踩出节奏。陈青山手一僵，把揣在怀里的那块“玄”字金属片往里按了按，另一只手顺势抄起一块废矿石，蹲下。

    心跳顶到嗓子眼。

    说真的，道爷我前世活了二十多年，加起来都没这么刺激过。前世顶多在网吧通宵的时候有人推门进来查身份证，现在倒好，黑漆漆的矿道里有人摸过来，连脚步声都没几个，贼刺激。

    你猜怎么着，他到的时候连那点声音都停了。矿道里黑，矿灯只照得见脚底下三尺地，积水里映出他自己一张白脸。过了十几息，动静又来了。还在靠近。

    这回连空气都跟着紧了。

    一个佝偻的身影从矿道拐角绕出来。满头白发稀稀拉拉贴在头皮上，背驼得像背了口锅，灰袍洗的发白，袖口的毛边都卷成了绳。手里拄着根木拐杖，表面油光水滑，一看就是握了几十年的老物件。

    陈青山心里过了一遍“执法堂”三个字，腿肚子没敢打颤——那更显眼。

    “哪里来的弟子？”声音沙哑，像砂纸蹭铁皮，但每个字都清清楚楚，贴着耳朵根子送过来。

    “外门，陈青山。”他答。

    老头看了他一眼。

    那眼神不好形容。不是打量，也不是审视，是称。称完了，还掂了掂分量，好像在算账。

    矿道里有积水，老头走过来的时候水面连个涟漪都没起。

    陈青山把这个细节吞进肚里，没吱声。

    说起来这老头看着像收破烂的，但他道爷我前世在电视上见过这种角色，不是扫地僧就是世外高人，后来打脸才知道不简单。所以别看现在问着“哪里来的弟子”，说不定下一秒就掏出一本九阳神功让他背。

    “怎么跑到这旧矿道来？这儿早废了。”老头拄着拐，拐头在地上戳了一下，戳出一声闷响。

    “听说有夹金丝矿石。”陈青山把手里的废矿石举起来，晃了晃，“来碰碰运气。”

    老头走过来，脚步真的一点声都没有。他接过矿石，指尖在石面上慢慢蹭过去，一寸一寸摸，像在摸一件老瓷器。

    “夹金丝？”老头抬眼瞅了他一下，“你小子倒是识货。”

    “以前在废器房混过。”陈青山答。

    他没多问。

    老头把矿石扔回来，陈青山一只手接住，入手沉。

    “这种矿石不能单炼。”老头说，“只能当引子。十斤精铁砂配一斤夹金丝，能出下品法器。”

    “……”

    陈青山没立刻答话。

    他脑子里过了一下：道爷我穿越过来这大半年，炼器堂的边都没摸过，这种配方在宗门里属于不传之秘，老头张嘴就来？再说了，这地方杂役都不乐意来，他一个糟老头蹲废矿道里等谁？

    “教我呢？”他试探。

    “老夫周伯。”老头语气跟说今天天气差不多，“以前在宗门炼器堂待过。”

    “以前”两个字，意味深长。可能是被赶出来的，也可能是犯了事被撵的。

    陈青山没接话。

    周伯转身往矿道深处走，走了两步，停了，没回头。

    “你进来的时候踩到了三块松动的石头。”

    陈青山一愣。

    “矿道塌过一次，里头结构不稳。往左边走三步，避开那条裂缝。”

    陈青山低头一看，脚下果然有一条裂缝，细长一条，被灰盖了大半。他走过来愣是没看见。

    后背一阵发凉。

    “多谢前辈。”

    周伯没搭理他，拐杖点在石头上，哒，哒，哒，背影消失在矿道拐角。

    陈青山没动。

    他在心里把刚才的事过了一遍。走路不带声，气息收得干净，看一眼就知道矿石的配方，扫一眼就能指出矿道里的裂缝。

    最少金丹期，而且不是刚摸到门槛的那种。

    他摸了摸怀里的金属片。

    “玄”字还烫着。

    识海里，造化鼎嗡的一声震了一下。不是之前喂矿石那种馋劲，是一种说不上来的悸动，像见了什么老相识。

    “跟不跟？”

    道爷我在废器房混了半年，什么阵仗没见过。再说了，一个金丹期的老前辈要弄他，犯得着提醒他避开裂缝？

    跟。

    矿道尽头有个石屋。四面岩壁凿出来的，门没关，一块破布帘子耷拉着。陈青山站在门口往里瞅：满屋子书，墙上挂着十几张炼器图谱，边角都卷了，桌上摆着几件半成品——一把缺口的剑胚，一个歪嘴的丹炉，一面裂缝的灵镜。半拉子活。

    最打眼的，是墙上一幅画像。

    画里人穿青色道袍，腰间挂一口巴掌大的小鼎，连道袍的褶子都画出来了。

    周伯就坐在画像底下那张破木椅上，闭着眼。

    “进来。”

    陈青山走进去，在对面坐下。石椅子，凉得屁股一激灵。

    周伯睁开眼。浑浊。眼白发黄，瞳孔灰蒙蒙的，像蒙了一层雾。

    “你叫什么？”

    “陈青山。”

    “外门杂役？”

    “是。”

    “来矿道几趟了？”

    “三次。”

    周伯没再问，从桌上拿起一块矿石扔过来。陈青山接住，入手冰凉，比寻常矿石沉一些。表面灰黑色，没纹路。

    “这是什么？”

    他掂了掂，翻过来看了看背面。没灵纹，没金属光泽，断面是均匀的粗颗粒。

    “普通铁矿石，不能用。”

    周伯又看了他一眼。又是那种称秤的眼神。

    “废器房待了多久？”

    “三个月。”

    “三个月能分清铁矿石和灵铁矿？”

    “废器房每天处理上百件废品。”陈青山把矿石搁下，“看多了就认识了。”

    周伯没接话，盯着他看了好一会儿。

    “行了。”老头忽然开口，“问你个事。”

    “您说。”

    “你捡了东西。”

    陈青山的手一僵。

    “石室里的那块。”周伯语气很平，跟说“你吃了个馒头”差不多，“刻着‘玄’字的金属片。”

    后背一阵凉意。

    “你进石室的时候我在外头。”周伯说，“门口灰上有两串脚印。一串进，一串出。进去的时候你一个人，出来的时候怀里多了东西。”

    陈青山没吭声。

    他脑子里飞速过选项：硬扛？金丹期吹口气都能把他吹墙上去。跑？矿道就一个出口，出去就是送菜。

    “前辈认错了吧。”他垂下眼帘，声音压得很低，带着几分恰到好处的恭敬，“晚辈就是来挖矿石的。”

    周伯盯着他。浑浊的眼睛里又闪过那丝精光。

    “你撒谎。”老头说，“那块金属片上有残余器韵。普通人碰到它，手心会有刺痛感。但你——”他顿了一下，“你什么反应都没有。”
content_en:
There is movement deep in the mine tunnel.
It wasn't the sound of footsteps, it was the sound of shoe soles scraping against gravel.Extremely light, but every step falls on the same point, creating a rhythm.Chen Qingshan's hand froze, and he pressed the metal piece with the word "Xuan" in his arms. He picked up a piece of waste ore with his other hand and squatted down.
My heart beat in my throat.
To be honest, Master Dao, I have lived for more than 20 years in my previous life, and in total, I have never experienced such excitement.In the previous life, when I was staying up all night at the Internet cafe, someone would open the door and come in to check my ID card. Now, it was better. Someone walked over in the dark mine tunnel, and there were not even a few footsteps. It was very exciting.
Guess what, even that little sound stopped when he arrived.It was dark in the mine tunnel, and the miner's lamp could only illuminate the ground three feet below his feet. His own white face was reflected in the water.After more than ten breaths, the movement came again.Still getting closer.
This time even the air was tight.
A rickety figure came around the corner of the mine tunnel.A head full of white hair sparsely stuck to his scalp, his back was hunched as if he was carrying a pot, his gray robe was washed white, and the raw edges of his sleeves were rolled into ropes.He was holding a wooden crutch in his hand. Its surface was smooth and oily, and it looked like an old object that he had held for decades.
Chen Qingshan thought about the words "Law Enforcement Hall" in his mind, but his calves didn't dare to tremble - it was more conspicuous.
"Where are you disciples from?" The voice was hoarse, like sandpaper rubbing against an iron sheet, but every word was heard clearly and was delivered close to the base of the ear.
"Outer door, Chen Qingshan." He answered.
The old man glanced at him.
That look is hard to describe.Not looking at it, not scrutinizing it, but weighing it.After weighing, I also weighed the weight, as if I was settling accounts.
There was water in the mine tunnel, and when the old man came over, there was not even a ripple in the water.
Chen Qingshan swallowed this detail without saying a word.
Speaking of which, this old man looks like a rag collector, but I have seen this kind of character on TV in my previous life. He was either a sweeping monk or a worldly master. After I was slapped in the face, I realized that it was not simple.So don't look at asking "Where is this disciple from?", maybe the next second he will take out a book of Nine Yang Magic and ask him to memorize it.
"Why did you come to this old mine tunnel? It has been abandoned long ago." The old man leaned on a crutch and poked the ground with his crutch, making a muffled sound.
"I heard there is gold ore in it." Chen Qingshan raised the waste ore in his hand and shook it, "Let's try our luck."
The old man walked over, his footsteps making no sound at all.He took the ore and slowly rubbed his fingertips on the stone surface, touching it inch by inch, like touching an old piece of porcelain.
"Pin gold thread?" The old man raised his eyes and glanced at him, "You know your stuff."
"I used to hang out in the waste equipment room." Chen Qingshan replied.
He didn't ask any more questions.
The old man threw the ore back, and Chen Qingshan caught it with one hand and held it heavy.
"This kind of ore cannot be smelted alone," the old man said, "it can only be used as a primer. Ten pounds of refined iron sand and one pound of gold wire can produce a low-grade magic weapon."
"..."
Chen Qingshan did not answer immediately.
He thought for a moment: Master Dao, I have not touched the side of the weapon refining hall in the more than half a year since I traveled through time. This kind of formula is a secret that is not passed down in the sect. The old man just opens his mouth?Besides, even the handymen are not willing to come to this place. Who is he, a bad old man, waiting for in an abandoned mine tunnel?
"Teach me?" he asked.
"I'm Uncle Zhou." The old man's tone was similar to that of today's weather. "I used to stay in the sect's weapon refining hall."
The word "previously" has a profound meaning.Maybe they were kicked out, or maybe they were kicked out after committing a crime.
Chen Qingshan did not answer.
Uncle Zhou turned around and walked deeper into the mine tunnel. After taking two steps, he stopped and did not look back.
"You stepped on three loose stones when you came in."
Chen Qingshan was stunned.
"The mine tunnel collapsed once, and the structure inside is unstable. Take three steps to the left to avoid the crack."
Chen Qingshan looked down and saw that there was indeed a crack under his feet. It was a long and thin crack, and it was mostly covered by dust.He walked over but didn't see it.
A chill ran down my back.
"Thank you, senior."
Uncle Zhou ignored him, tapped his crutch on the stone, click, click, click, and his back disappeared around the corner of the mine tunnel.
Chen Qingshan did not move.
He went through what had just happened in his mind.He walked silently and kept his breath clean. He could tell the formula of the ore at a glance, and he could point out the cracks in the mine tunnel at a glance.
At least the golden elixir stage, and not the kind that just touched the threshold.
He touched the metal piece in his arms.
The word "Xuan" is still hot.
In the sea of ​​consciousness, the Cauldron of Creation vibrated with a buzzing sound.It wasn't the greedy feeling I had when I was fed the ore before, but an indescribable throbbing, as if I had seen an old acquaintance.
"Follow or not?"
Master Dao, I have been working in the waste equipment room for half a year, and I have never seen any battles.Besides, if a senior at the Golden Core stage wants to mess with him, why should he remind him to avoid the cracks?
and.
There is a stone house at the end of the mine tunnel.It was carved out of the rock walls on all sides, with the door open and a rag curtain hanging down.Chen Qingshan stood at the door and looked in: the room was full of books, and there were more than a dozen weapon refining diagrams hanging on the wall, with the corners rolled, and there were several semi-finished products on the table - a chipped sword embryo, a crooked alchemy furnace, and a cracked spiritual mirror.Half a job.
The most eye-catching thing is a portrait on the wall.
The person in the painting is wearing a blue Taoist robe, with a palm-sized cauldron hanging on his waist, and even the pleats of the Taoist robe are drawn.
Uncle Zhou sat on the broken wooden chair under the portrait, eyes closed.
"Come in."
Chen Qingshan walked in and sat down opposite.The stone chair was so cold that my buttocks trembled.
Uncle Zhou opened his eyes.turbid.The whites of his eyes were yellow, and his pupils were gray, as if covered with a layer of fog.
"What's your name?"
"Chen Qingshan."
"Outside doorman?"
"yes."
"How many times have you been to the mine tunnel?"
"three times."
Uncle Zhou didn't ask anymore, picked up a piece of ore from the table and threw it over.Chen Qingshan caught it and felt it was cold, heavier than ordinary ore.The surface is gray-black and has no texture.
"What's this?"
He weighed it, turned it over and looked at the back.There is no spiritual pattern or metallic luster, and the cross section is uniformly coarse grained.
"Ordinary iron ore cannot be used."
Uncle Zhou looked at him again.It's that weighing look again.
"How long have you been in the waste equipment room?"
"Three months."
"Can you tell the difference between iron ore and spiritual iron ore in three months?"
"The waste equipment room handles hundreds of pieces of waste every day." Chen Qingshan put down the ore, "You will know it after seeing it too much."
Uncle Zhou didn't answer and stared at him for a long time.
"Okay." The old man suddenly said, "I want to ask you something."
"You said."
"You picked something up."
Chen Qingshan's hand froze.
"The piece in the stone chamber." Uncle Zhou's tone was very calm, almost like saying "You ate a steamed bun." "The metal piece with the word 'Xuan' engraved on it."
A chill ran down my back.
"I was outside when you entered the stone chamber." Uncle Zhou said, "There are two sets of footprints on the dust at the door. One goes in, the other comes out. You were alone when you went in, and you had something in your arms when you came out."
Chen Qingshan said nothing.
His mind raced through options: Carry it hard?Jin Danqi could blow him up the wall if he breathed.run?There is only one exit in the mine tunnel, and when you go out, you can deliver food.
"Senior, you must admit your mistake." He lowered his eyes and spoke in a very low voice, with just the right amount of respect, "Junior is here to dig for ore."
Uncle Zhou stared at him.The gleam of light flashed in the cloudy eyes again.
"You're lying." The old man said, "There are residual artifacts on that piece of metal. Ordinary people will feel a tingling sensation in their palms when they touch it. But you -" he paused, "you didn't react at all."
